title: Evidence hardening: PDF/base64 DoS (SEC2-005/006), estimate grand total, medium findings
story: Fix SEC2-005, SEC2-006, estimateTotal parts-subtotal bug, and evidence medium findings (SEC2-012, SEC2-017)
acceptance: parse.mjs has no unbounded lazy regex over content: BT/ET and stream/endstream are found by a linear indexOf scanner; caps on stream count and total scanned bytes plus a wall-clock budget (graceful partial result, no throw to the client)
zlib.inflateSync is called with maxOutputLength; an over-limit stream is skipped, not fatal
routes.mjs validates contentBase64 with a length check then a linear scan or Buffer round-trip; no regex with trailing \s* after a greedy class

tests/unit/evidence/dos.test.mjs: adversarial inputs (300KB 'BT ' without ET, 700KB repeated 'stream\n', 300KB flate bomb inflating to 300MB, 80,000 spaces plus '!' base64) each complete in under 200 ms; valid PDFs and base64 (with line breaks) still parse/accept; invalid base64 gets 400
estimateTotal equals the grand total (e.g. parts 2090 + labor 1798 + tax) not the parts subtotal; test with a synthetic estimate covering Grand total/Total due labels and ignoring Parts subtotal

SEC2-012: getAcceptedFacts only returns AI fields that are accepted===true (or from staff-uploaded sources), claimant-sourced values stay suggestions; SEC2-017: extraction fields with pii:true masked for auditor and integration roles; tests for both

node --test --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tests/unit/evidence/ passes; the t.todo for SEC2-005/006 in tests/security/sec2-availability-ai.test.mjs would pass (run only that file read-only); result notes the security hub post
brief: Work inside src/modules/evidence/ and tests/unit/evidence/ only. Read parse.mjs (lines ~85 and ~102-104), routes.mjs (~41, ~77, shape() ~12), service.mjs (~82, ~181, getAcceptedFacts ~230). 1) Replace the regexes in parse.mjs with a linear scanner using Buffer/string indexOf from a moving cursor (each step must advance); a missing ET or endstream ends the scan. Add constants for MAX_STREAMS, MAX_SCAN_BYTES, MAX_INFLATE_BYTES (e.g. 5MB) and a deadline check using performance.now() (e.g. 100 ms) in the loops; return what was gathered so far. inflateSync with {maxOutputLength} throws RangeError on overflow: catch and skip that stream. 2) routes.mjs: reject if length > ceil(15MB*4/3) first; then validate by a charCode loop (A-Za-z0-9+/ and whitespace, up to two trailing '=') or Buffer.from(...,'base64') and compare re-encoded length after whitespace strip; no regex backtracking. 3) Estimate extraction: find the labelled grand total (Grand total, Total due, Amount due, Total estimate) and prefer it over Parts/Subtotal lines; if only a subtotal exists, fall back to parts+labor+tax if those are present. Triage uses estimateTotal for suggestedReserve and Aurelia STP < 2500, so under-reporting is a business risk. 4) SEC2-012 gate: check src/modules/triage/facts.mjs consumers and existing tests so you do not break them; if triage tests depend on auto-accept, keep a compatible accepted flag and document the smallest change; post a contract-change if the accept semantics need to change. 5) SEC2-017: mask pii:true fields in extraction response for roles auditor and integration, mirroring claims PII_ROLES. Pitfalls: ctx.db of the tenant-bound ctx only; no real data; do not edit tests/security (read-only); don't edit package.json; do not commit. Time-based assertions should use generous but meaningful 200 ms bounds. When done post to the security hub: node org/cli.mjs post security result "SEC2-005/006 fixed" --ticket S3-AI-01 and set the ticket to review.
valueDrivers: Availability: one claimant upload can no longer stall every tenant
Accurate reserves and STP decisions from correct estimate totals

verdicts.reason: All criteria met; 27 evidence tests pass (files glob); DoS/base64/grand-total/SEC2-012/017 verified; e2e/security failures match baseline
